messages:
Maya Patel: quick q — how do we want the autofallback decision to pick between 'degraded-mode' (e.g. token-trimming/heuristic) vs full region/capacity fallback? thinking about UX during rollouts.
Ethan Cho: i'd split by trigger type: transient errors -> degraded-mode, persistent capacity/regional SLO breach -> region fallback. thresholds configurable.
Simon Park: +1. also need a cooldown so we don't flip back and forth. maybe exponential backoff on re-enable.
Lena Ortiz: We should show this clearly in the Console rollout card. minimal UX idea: current route, active fallback mode, last 5 triggers, 'force override' button with required reason + audit entry.
Maya Patel: agree. do we let users pick automatic fallback for both error-classes or force manual for degraded-mode?
Ethan Cho: allow both but default to auto for degraded-mode (lower blast radius). manual override for region fallback because it has infra/cost implications.
Simon Park: telemetry-wise we must capture: trigger_type, metric_value, decision_reason, model_variant, capacity_source. those as structured fields in audit log.
Lena Ortiz: UI mock notes: show a concise banner in rollout details: "Active fallback: degraded-mode (auto) — last triggered 3m ago — view audit". clicking audit opens chronological entries with JSON payloads.
Maya Patel: ok what about the decision tree itself? sketch: 1) is request error-type (5xx, model OOM)? if yes -> degraded-mode if below degraded_slo_threshold; 2) if latency or throughput SLO violated for >rolling_window -> attempt region fallback. fallback only if region capacity available and permission.
Ethan Cho: here's a simplified config snippet we can expose in API/Console (draft):
```json
{
  "fallback_policy": {
    "degraded_mode": {"enabled": true, "error_triggers": ["5xx","oom"], "auto_cooldown_s": 120},
    "region_fallback": {"enabled": false, "slo_pct_threshold": 0.99, "window_s": 300}
  }
}
```
Lena Ortiz: UI should let teams edit those numbers with a clear tooltip: "Changes will be recorded in audit and may be overridden by org admin".
Simon Park: Add requirement: every automatic fallback must create an immutable audit entry + optional alert to a configured pager channel. no silent switches.
Maya Patel: sounds good. can we also list the expected cost delta for region fallback (estimate) in the rollout panel? product asked for that.
Ethan Cho: we can compute a conservative estimate from unit_costs and recent token volume. show range: +- 20%. label as estimate.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary job 5234: rollout v2 -> degraded-mode enabled by policy (auto) — health checks still failing on us-west-2.
Maya Patel: thanks bot. action items: 1) ethan – draft API fields for fallback_policy; 2) lena – mockup for rollout card + audit viewer; 3) simon – spec for audit schema + pager hooks. i'll own docs & UX copy.
Ethan Cho: will do.
Lena Ortiz: will start mock tonight.
Simon Park: i'll stub schema and send proto.
Maya Patel: cool. tagging @ops for visibility later. :thumbsup:
